text: Madame Forestier went to her wardrobe. <break time="0.8s" /> Took out a large jewel box. <break time="0.8s" /> And said, Choose, my dear. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly in a black satin box. <break time="0.8s" /> She found a superb diamond necklace. <break time="0.8s" /> And her heart began to beat. <break time="0.8s" /> With desire. <break time="0.8s" /> Can you lend me this, only this. <break time="0.8s" /> She asked. <break time="0.8s" /> And her friend said. <break time="0.8s" /> Why, yes, of course. <break time="0.8s" /> At the ball. <break time="0.8s" /> Madame Loisel was a great success. <break time="0.8s" /> For she was prettier. <break time="0.8s" /> Than all the other women. <break time="0.8s" /> All the men looked at her. <break time="0.8s" /> And asked her name. <break time="0.8s" /> And even the Minister. <break time="0.8s" /> Noticed her. <break time="0.8s" /> She danced wildly. <break time="0.8s" /> Drunk with pleasure. <break time="0.8s" /> In a cloud of happiness. <break time="0.8s" /> Made of all this admiration. <break time="0.8s" /> They left. <break time="0.8s" /> At about four in the morning. <break time="0.8s" /> And her husband put around her shoulders. <break time="0.8s" /> The simple coat he had brought. <break time="0.8s" /> Its poorness clashed. <break time="0.8s" /> With the elegance of her ball dress. <break time="0.8s" /> So she hurried away. <break time="0.8s" /> To avoid being seen. <break time="0.8s" /> By the rich women. <break time="0.8s" /> At home she took off her coat. <break time="0.8s" /> Before the mirror. <break time="0.8s" /> To see herself. <break time="0.8s" /> In all her glory. <break time="0.8s" /> Once more. <break time="0.8s" /> But suddenly she gave a cry. <break time="0.8s" /> For the necklace. <break time="0.8s" /> Was no longer around her neck.
